name: lugas
description: Lugas: free, local, meaning-safe paraphrase, editing, and translation for Indonesian and English academic writing.

interface.longDescription: Edit, paraphrase, correct, and translate academic and technical Indonesian and English without changing numbers, citations, negation, hedges, or claim strength. Includes an offline meaning guard and EYD V lint.
defaultPrompt: Parafrasekan paragraf ini tanpa mengubah angka, sitasi, atau kekuatan klaim.
Rapikan bahasa bab metode ini sesuai EYD V.
Check whether this paraphrase preserves the evidence.
Translate this abstract into academic English; keep every number and citation.
Give three cautious ways to state this research gap.
